title: Battle of Blumenau
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Blumenau", at revision 1370434663, opens: "The Battle of Blumenau or Battle of Lamač was the last battle fought in the Austro-Prussian War, on 22 July 1866, with the Austrians defending against the Prussian army." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q561512, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1866 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
